 Prime Video is pioneering the use of Generative AI to empower the next generation of creatives. Our mission is to make world\-class media creation accessible, scalable and efficient.
   

  

 We are seeking an Applied Scientist to advance the state of the art in Generative AI and to deliver these innovations as production\-ready systems at Amazon scale. Your work will give creators unprecedented freedom and control while driving new efficiencies.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As an Applied Scientist, you will have end\-to\-end ownership of the product, related research and experimentation. In addition, you will be applying advanced machine learning techniques in Computer Vision, Multimedia Understanding and Generative AI.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 We're building the foundational technology stack, spanning diffusion and flow\-matching models, 3D/4D scene and character generation, motion and camera control, and post\-training alignment. Other responsibilities include:
   

  

* Research and develop generative models for controllable synthesis across images, video, vector graphics, and multimedia
* Innovate in advanced diffusion and flow\-based methods (e.g., inverse flow matching, parameter efficient training, guided sampling, test\-time adaptation) to improve efficiency, controllability, and scalability
* Advance visual grounding, depth and 3D estimation, segmentation, and matting for integration into pre\-visualization, compositing, VFX, and post\-production pipelines
* Design multimodal GenAI workflows including visual\-language model tooling, structured prompt orchestration, agentic pipelines

**Preferred Qualifications**

**Description**
 Join us as a Software Development Engineer on the AI Studios Engineering org within Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios, where you'll build intelligent systems at the intersection of AI and cinematic storytelling. This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to Nara, our AI\-native content creation platform that empowers creators to produce professional animation and live action content featuring world\-class intellectual properties at unprecedented speed and scale.   In this role, you'll develop production\-quality code for AI\-powered creative tools while learning from experienced engineers and scientists. You'll work alongside creative professionals (animators, filmmakers, and storytellers) implementing features that directly transform how animation and live action/VFX content is made for Prime Video's most ambitious productions. This is an ideal opportunity for engineers who are passionate about AI/ML applications in entertainment and want to grow their skills while contributing to industry\-defining products featuring iconic IPs.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Design, develop, and maintain software components for our AI\-native content creation platform, supporting professional animation and live action/VFX workflows   Implement features across the stack—from backend services, media processing pipelines, and APIs to ML model integrations and creator\-facing tooling—with guidance from senior engineers   Write clean, well\-tested, and maintainable code while participating in code reviews to both give and receive constructive feedback   Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including ML scientists, applied scientists, product managers, and creative professionals to understand requirements and deliver solutions   Contribute to integrations with industry\-standard Digital Content Creation (DCC) tools such as Adobe Animate, After Effects, Maya, and Storyboard Pro   Troubleshoot and debug issues in production systems, contributing to operational excellence and system reliability   Participate in on\-call rotations and contribute to improving system monitoring, alerting, and documentation   Continuously learn new technologies, tools, and methodologies relevant to AI/ML systems, media processing, and distributed computing
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 As an SDE on the AI Studios team, you'll spend most of your time writing and reviewing code, with regular opportunities to collaborate with teammates on design discussions. A typical day might include building API endpoints for our creator tooling platform, implementing new features for our live action VFX pipeline, or debugging an integration with our proprietary AI models. What makes this role unique is the opportunity to work on\-site alongside VFX artists and creative professionals, sitting with them as they use your tools, watching where workflows break down, and iterating rapidly to meet the demands of production timelines. You'll participate in team standups, sprint planning, and retrospectives while building your understanding of our systems. You'll have opportunities to learn from experienced engineers and gradually take on more complex challenges as you grow, all while working on technology that powers content featuring world\-class IPs.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We're part of the Engineering org within newly established Prime Video's AI Studios Division, pioneering AI\-native cinematic content creation. Our mission is to establish Amazon MGM Studios as the definitive leader in AI\-enabled content creation—giving creators unprecedented control over AI outputs while materially reducing production costs and timelines for animation and live action productions featuring world\-class intellectual properties.   Our engineering team spans distributed systems engineers building scalable infrastructure, ML engineers optimizing model training and inference, and full\-stack engineers crafting intuitive interfaces for creative collaboration. We're building Nara, our AI\-native platform, along with proprietary AI models (Genies) for animation, Live Action/VFX copilots, and integrations with industry\-standard creative tools. We work in a fast\-paced, innovative environment where you'll contribute to technology transforming how iconic entertainment content is made.
